title: How to tell if your AI platforms’ accounts have been hacked
summary: Then, on ChatGPT’s website, click “Log in” located in the bottom-left corner, enter your email address, click on “Forgot password,” and then “Continue.” ChatGPT will then send you an email containing a six-digit code.
